title: harvest-qa: merge its own log pull request on green
summary: /harvest-qa's closing phase merges its log pull request on green with dev-next's merge steps (never on red or pending), its summary says whether it merged, and a Who-merges section quotes the baseline. Version 31.
friction: The dev's Windows-part 'before' suite count was taken while edits were in progress (it read 79, main is 77); only CI's main run was a clean before-measure.
lessons_learned: Take the before-suite run on a clean worktree before the first edit; the Windows part reads the working folder.
